def solve(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]; h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    # horizontal line rows: rows containing nonzero
    hrows=[r for r in range(h) if any(v for v in g[r])]
    # fill gaps within a horizontal row between same-color runs (extend laterally, stop at other colors)
    for r in hrows:
        row=g[r]
        # for each colored segment, extend over zeros until a different nonzero color
        for c in range(w):
            if row[c]:
                col=row[c]
                # extend left and right over zeros
                j=c-1
                while j>=0 and row[j]==0: row[j]=col; j-=1
                j=c+1
                while j<w and row[j]==0: row[j]=col; j+=1
    # vertical lines: columns with nonzero cells not part of horizontal rows
    for c in range(w):
        colcells=[(r,g[r][c]) for r in range(h) if g[r][c] and r not in hrows]
        if not colcells: continue
        color=colcells[0][1]
        # extend upward from topmost such cell
        top=min(r for r,v in colcells)
        r=top-1
        while r>=0:
            v=g[r][c]
            if v==0:
                g[r][c]=color; r-=1
            elif v==color:
                r-=1
            else:
                # hit a different color (horizontal row): relay that color upward
                relay=v; r-=1
                while r>=0 and g[r][c]==0:
                    g[r][c]=relay; r-=1
                break
    return g
